scope: new causal spline-bank mechanism experiment; not a historical AMA/MN rerun or a full KAN/Transformer
lr_schedule: constant through step 999, cosine decay to 0.0003 over steps 1000..1499
allocation: exactly two task-private 12-coefficient splines; fixed budget; physically stored only for selected task IDs; not adaptive count, not split/merge
conflict_score: sum over other tasks of max(0,-inner_product(shared_gradient_t,shared_gradient_u)), averaged over 50 pre-allocation updates
loss_score: training per-task MSE averaged over the same 50 updates
pcgrad: only shared c/D block; random original-task-gradient projection order per row, average aggregation; code/private updates ordinary; joint arm starts PCGrad after allocation
oracle: weighted centered rank-r SVD certifies empirical or population mean-MSE infimum; private_oracle chooses mask by exhaustive training-only SVD; no teacher/test mask access
teacher: cubic splines; related centered rank2; partial adds two orthogonal exception functions; unrelated centered rank up to 7; known task IDs and one scalar input
population_integral: 8-node Gauss-Legendre quadrature on each knot interval; exact for products of cubic splines up to floating error
fresh_gate: integrity/tests/finite outputs/serialization only; no efficacy gate because null results are a primary aim; no retuning after development
H1: negative cosine does not imply failure: verify exact compatible quadratic counterexample
H2_gate: PCGrad only: >=5% lower worst-task population MSE and <=1% mean-MSE increase, >=4/5 fresh worlds after median over 3 init seeds, separately per regime; same storage, not equal walltime
H3_gate: private_conflict vs rank2 on partial: >=5% lower mean and worst MSE in >=4/5 worlds; added bytes explicitly charged
H4_gate: selector specificity: private_conflict beats BOTH private_loss and private_random on worst MSE by >=5%, mean no worse by >1%, in >=4/5 partial worlds; same exact bytes; also compare rank3/native
novelty_control: rank2 Mirror coefficient formulation is algebraically identical to ordinary shared low-rank spline dictionary; no Mirror-specific invention claim
inference_codec: fixed binary header with degree/domain/task/basis/rank/private counts, all float64 tensors, uint32 selected task IDs; no hidden teacher state; no quantization
runtime: separate isolated raw-input prediction benchmark, batch1 and64, one CPU thread, 30 warmups then 5 groups of 100 calls; median/range; clocks not locked
uncertainty: 5 independent worlds are statistical units; 3 initializations are nested, not 15 independent data replicates; report world-median paired differences/ranges; no universal or production claim
stop: fixed 1500 updates; abort on nonfinite/corrupt state; preserve all results and any amendments; do not change MA registry or main
